comment: 12yo female, infantile-onset epilepsy + facial angiofibromas + multiple cortical tubers on brain MRI + bilateral renal angiomyolipomas, confirmed germline TSC2 pathogenic variant on diagnostic panel. No personal malignancy diagnosis (AMLs are benign hamartomas, SEGA absent at this point). Engine fires RF-TSC-CONFIRMED-CARRIER → routes to PreventionPlan: standard = IND-TSC-CARRIER-SURVEILLANCE; aggressive = IND-TSC-CARRIER-INTENSIFIED. Validates Wave O TSC confirmed-carrier pilot.
